description: Payment gateway service completely down in the primary region and all transactions failing.
Order service pods crash looping after node memory exhaustion and orders failing for some users.
Customer portal returns server errors for all users right after a certificate renewal.
Reporting dashboard very slow during month end because of heavy database queries.
Checkout API latency increased sharply after the latest deployment and users see timeouts.
Checkout response time doubled after the release with slow database calls and timeouts at peak.
After deployment the checkout service is slow with timeouts and the error rate is rising.
Checkout latency is high again since the new release and customers abandon their carts.
Suspicious logins from unknown locations using a service account credential found in logs.
Malware alert on a developer laptop that has access to the build servers.
Phishing email clicked by an employee and mailbox rules forwarding mail to an external address.
A batch job overwrote customer records in the orders table and the data must be recovered.
Storage corruption on the primary database causes missing transactions from the last day.
Duplicate records created by a misconfigured data sync job.
New joiner cannot access the code repository and needs standard developer permissions.
Contractor access to the production support tool expired and needs urgent renewal.
Single sign on fails for a group of finance users after an identity provider change.
Release pipeline failed at the database migration step and the deployment stopped halfway.
Production deployment introduced a configuration error and several services restarted unexpectedly.
Staging deployment failing because of a missing environment variable.
VPN tunnel to the data centre dropped and branch applications are unreachable.
Intermittent packet loss between the application servers and the database subnet.
DNS resolution failing for one internal service after a configuration change.
